full_page.content:
Page 200 Cont.
Apr. 1 Mrs. Isabelle McVoy - 51 - bad case of gall-stones. - husband & boys anxious .... Husband in poor health too - blood poison
Alice Bidigare - 46 - hardening of Eye-ball - becoming quite threatening .... Cath. Fedoo1 - 65 - of Windsor - Rhumatism Lillian O'Neil - 56 - gall-Bl.
Page 201
Apr. 2 Mrs. Gertrude 0'Donnell - 61 - intestinal obstructions & gall- stones.
2 Mrs. Margaret Sturdevan - 52 - internal goitre .... operation To-mor. Peter O'Grady - 17 - a twin Tuomer on brain feared .... severe head- aches since Good Friday.
W. Hagerty & Brother in 30's out of Church - neglecting sacraments - Mother and friends anxious.
Eliz Treese - 23 - spine --- operation expected ....
8 Everett Varreau - 18 - stiffened spine from one end to other - has many friends ... All Traverse City said to be watching him.
James Paquette - 9 - very figety nerveous etc. Has much trouble in school .....
8 Stanley - 6 - tuomer removed from brain January 23 - case seemed en- tirely hopeless. Drs. quite astonished that he lived; is here To- day .... remarkably bright and alert. Deo Gr. (Feb. 28)
Page 202 April 8 Mrs. Ida Ryan - 66 - Stroke Feb. 22nd - whole left side lame - diffi- cult to eat - still hopes to be able to come hither.
Charlotte Putze - 55 - peculiar ailment Drs. at sea just what to say.
9 Thanks - Mrs. Anna Marie Chauvin - 54 - LaSall, Ont. - tuomer on spine just between the sholders - all hopes had vanished - was enrolled perpetually - made "54 day Novena" - Quite Okay -- Shoping
